description: Check that the web pages your ACTIVE ads send people to actually open (read-only; changes nothing in Snap). Each distinct link is opened once from this computer, over https only and never to private addresses; redirects are followed and checked. Flags broken (404), server errors, slow, unreachable and non-https links, and links that end up on another site. Optional required_params (e.g. ["utm_source"]) flags links that lack them. It cannot see 'out of stock' text inside a page that opens.
name: snap_check_landing_pages
